scope: Primary documentation consulted; selected public historical documents statically inspected and hashed. No API cohort queries or new empirical calculations.

web_sources.title: European Union: EU countries, page 1
web_sources.scope: Official roster: 27 member-country pages; first 20 names inspected. Country inclusion is fixed independently of OA outcomes.

web_sources.title: European Union: EU countries, page 2
web_sources.scope: Remaining seven members inspected: Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain and Sweden.

web_sources.title: OpenAlex: Countries
web_sources.scope: Country identifiers use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. The fixed protocol uses GR for Greece, not the Eurostat EL label.

web_sources.title: OpenAlex: Open access
web_sources.scope: Six scalar work statuses: diamond, gold, green, hybrid, bronze and closed. A work may have several access locations. The provider classification is not an independent licence, embargo or policy-compliance audit. Bronze includes free publisher access without an identified open licence; green denotes repository availability with toll access at the publisher.

web_sources.title: OpenAlex: Filter
web_sources.scope: Comma-separated filters are conjunctive; values are case-insensitive. No paid created/updated-date filters are used.

web_sources.title: OpenAlex: Group
web_sources.scope: group_by counts matching works. include_unknown includes missing/empty field values; the string-field unknown key is unknown. meta.count is the matched-work count; groups_count concerns the current page, not proof of complete pagination.

web_sources.title: OpenAlex: Work attributes
web_sources.scope: publication_year, type and open_access.oa_status are work fields. Provider indexing, record merging and classification delimit the population.

web_sources.title: OpenAlex: API reference
web_sources.scope: Basic public HTTP queries need no key; metadata are CC0. Default works corpus is core, which is distinct from any CWTS core-publication definition.

web_sources.title: OpenAlex: Authentication
web_sources.scope: Anonymous basic use is documented, with 10 requests per second. Cursor paging beyond the first page needs a key. This design uses no account, key, cursor, payment or credential.

web_sources.title: OpenAlex: Work types
web_sources.scope: article is a provider-assigned controlled type. It is not independently verified peer review. Type classification changes over time, so response bytes are frozen.

web_sources.title: OpenAlex: Authorships
web_sources.scope: authorships.institutions.country_code filters mapped institutions. authorships.countries can additionally use countries extracted directly from an unmatched raw address; these filters are therefore not silently substituted.

web_sources.title: OpenAlex: Expansion corpus
web_sources.scope: The corpus selector has core, expansion and all views; core is the default. The amendment pins corpus=core explicitly and does not combine legacy XPAC controls.

web_sources.title: OpenAlex: How it is built
web_sources.scope: The database evolves daily, merges records and maps affiliations. Metadata are released under CC0. A small acquisition batch is a local extract, not an atomic snapshot of the full provider database.

web_sources.title: cOAlition S: Guidance on the Implementation of Plan S
web_sources.scope: Compliance requires applicable funding/policy conditions and immediate access with appropriate version and rights. OA colours alone do not establish it. No Plan S compliance variable is constructed.
